Container.Name: valetudo-restore
Container.Overview: Backup, monitoring and automatic restore for Valetudo on rooted Dreame/Mova robots. These robots periodically factory-reset themselves and wipe /data, destroying Valetudo along with its config, map and Wi-Fi settings. This container takes nightly SSH backups of everything irreplaceable (including the per-robot calibration and identity data), watches for a wipe, notifies you, and can put it all back automatically.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the valetudo-restore web interface

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, event database, SSH key and the cached Valetudo binary

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone - controls when the nightly backup runs

Config.Name: Robot IP
Config.Description: Robot IP or hostname. Seeds the initial config; the web UI is authoritative afterwards.

Config.Name: Backup hour
Config.Description: Hour (0-23) for the nightly backup. Keep it before the robot's own 03:00-05:00 reboot.

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: How many backup archives to retain before pruning the oldest.

Config.Name: Auto-restore
Config.Description: Automatically restore when a wipe is CONFIRMED. Off by default - a restore writes to the robot.

Config.Name: Webhook URL
Config.Description: Notification webhook (Home Assistant, ntfy, Discord...). Leave empty to disable notifications.
